remarks: Discover the perfect blend of tranquility and versatility in this stunning center hall colonial home with over 4000sf and nestled on a picturesque 2+ acre lot on one of New Canaan's most sought-after cul-de-sacs. Just one minute from West School and a short drive to town and the train station, this residence offers an ideal location for living and commuting. Bright and updated, this 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom home is designed to maximize natural light and comfort. The expansive front-to-back living room features a charming fireplace, while the oversized dining room provides ample space for gatherings. The heart of the home is the beautifully updated kitchen, complete with a center island, stainless steel appliances, exquisite stone countertops, and a charming breakfast area. The spacious family room, highlighted by a cozy fireplace, opens through walls of French doors to a lovely terrace, making it perfect for entertaining or enjoying serene outdoor moments. A convenient walk-out den on the lower level is equipped with a wet bar and a dedicated workout area, enhancing the home's functionality. Additionally, a two-car garage and plenty of storage space, making this well-appointed home the perfect retreat for country living. Don't miss the opportunity to make this your dream home!
